_comment: Consumed by .github/workflows/red-green-gate.yml. See README.md in this directory for the contract, what the gate refuses, its value constraints (values must be shell-safe: no double quotes, backticks, dollar signs or backslashes) and its honest limits. Only the entry for the pushed ref is exercised per run. kind selects the leg: 'rust' runs cargo test --lib and compares the whole #[cfg(test)] region; 'integration' runs cargo test --test <test_target> against the job's postgres service and compares the whole test file (a skipped test is refused, so it cannot pass vacuously); 'frontend' runs vitest and compares the whole frontend-relative test file. test_path is frontend-relative for frontend and repo-relative otherwise. The _evidence fields are documentation only.

_evidence.base: NOT C0: stacked on the verified limiter pair — 7f4b2a7f (limiter test) then 67e6f76d (limiter fix) then 4104c3c5 (setup test) then 27ab610b (setup fix); both limiter SHAs verified as ancestors
_evidence.why_this_test: the mission's Phase 7 asks for a test proving the shared budget conflicts with the approved independent-quota policy. A config-surface assertion does not, and the in-crate limiter test passes on BOTH sides because it constructs the instances it asserts about (patch 0002 says the same). This is a live-HTTP regression against the real binary: it boots the app on a throwaway database, consumes the setup route's budget, and asserts /api/auth/register still has its own quota.

_evidence.green_run: exit 0; register after the setup burst: 400; the startup line gains `setup: 2/3600 s`. Units: config_file tests 11 passed, setup_budget_config_tests 1 passed, setup_rate_limit_budget_tests 2 passed, rate_limit tests 4 passed
